about: The postcommunio of the formulary “Third Sunday of Lent” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: We beseech You, O Lord, graciously absolve us from all guilt and danger, whom You grant to partake of so great a mystery. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.

a.g: Appeased, we beseech You, Lord, absolve us from all guilt and dangers
You grant to be partakers of so great a mystery
who lives and reigns with You
